subject: Request: SummitPeak combined credits + discount + SLA carveout
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana@summitpeak.com>, SummitPeak Legal <legal@summitpeak.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SummitPeak combined credits + discount + SLA carveout

Team — looping you both for quick executive sign-off on a combined concession request from SummitPeak. Context in short: SummitPeak is a target strategic partner — they run a sizable data platform in adtech and have told us they’ll anchor our Dedicated product in APAC if the pilot goes well. They completed a 6-week PoC with good perf results but want stronger economics to commit to a 2-year reserved capacity deal.

They’ve requested the following concessions to finalize an LOI next week: 
- 40% first-year discount on Dedicated capacity pricing (applies to committed GPUs for year 1)
- $25,000 in free usage credits applied toward the pilot + a 90-day extension of the pilot window
- A temporary SLA carveout: pilot SLA target of 99.9% availability and looser latency SLO (99th percentile latency allowance for pilot) until full production onboarding

Why I’m asking for approval: SummitPeak has already committed to the product integration (engineering and SRE time invested), indicated a willingness to sign a 24-month contract post-pilot, and is being courted by two competitors who can match baseline pricing but not our observability/route/caching capabilities. The economic ask is substantial but the account could deliver ~ $1.2M ARR over 24 months if we win the full deal.

Attachments: usage report and a draft SOW (see attached). I included SummitPeak legal on the cc because they want visibility on the SLA carveout language.

Request: can I get an exec decision on whether to grant the combined package as-is or propose a counter (see Marissa’s note below)? Prefer a concrete answer today so we can respond to their LOI timeline. If approved, I’ll instruct legal to proceed with redlines and Marissa will finalize the pricing table.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SummitPeak_usage_report_q3.csv (csv), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana@summitpeak.com>, SummitPeak Legal <legal@summitpeak.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SummitPeak combined credits + discount + SLA carveout

Diego — I’m supportive of offering concessions given the strategic upside, but I want to propose a slightly smaller package to protect our margin while keeping the deal compelling. My recommended counter: 
- 35% first-year discount on dedicated capacity (vs 40%)
- $20k free usage credits + 60-day pilot extension (vs $25k + 90 days)
- SLA: allow the pilot SLA relaxation for availability (99.9% target) but keep latency SLOs aligned with our standard 99th percentile target; operationally we can provide a detailed mitigation plan if latency drift occurs

If leadership prefers the full ask to accelerate closing (and accept the hit to margin), I can live with that — but I want explicit approval so Finance and Legal know the boundary. I’ve attached an updated pricing_table_redwood_20261123.xlsx with margin impact highlighted.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 (650) 555-4320

Attachment: pricing_table_redwood_20261123.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana@summitpeak.com>, SummitPeak Legal <legal@summitpeak.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SummitPeak combined credits + discount + SLA carveout

Diego / Marissa — thanks for the clear framing and the pricing workbook. Quick take from Sales Ops / Finance perspective: the full ask (40% + $25k credits + 90 days) reduces our first-year margin on this ARR bucket to single digits and would set a concerning precedent in APAC for similar anchor deals.

That said, I don’t want to lose the account. My conditional recommendation: approve a concession package up to the numbers Marissa suggested (35% / $20k / 60 days) but with the following guardrails: 
- Require a minimum 12-month committed spend (not just pilot conversion intent) in the LOI before credits are applied
- Include a rollback clause: if product metrics or usage forecasts fall below agreed thresholds after 60 days in production, credits are clawed back or discounted amortized over first two invoices
- Legal must approve SLA language; no permanent precedent for relaxed latency SLOs in final contract — pilot carveouts must be timeboxed and tied to specific remediation checkpoints

If Sales wants to keep the original ask to close faster, I’ll escalate to Finance for one-off approval but will need a clear P&L impact paper — I can turn that around in 24 hours if needed.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SummitPeak combined credits + discount + SLA carveout

Team — reviewed Marissa’s margins and Evelyn’s guardrails. I authorize the following one-time concession to close the LOI, on the conditions below: 
- Approved concession: 35% first-year discount, $20,000 usage credits, 60-day pilot extension.
- SLA: temporary availability target of 99.9% for the pilot is permitted; latency SLOs remain at standard thresholds. Any explicit latency exception must be timeboxed and documented in the SOW.
- Conditions: 1) Deal must include a signed 12-month minimum committed spend clause before credits apply; 2) Legal to incorporate a clawback/amortization clause for credits tied to post-pilot production metrics; 3) Finance to record an ARR impact memo and route to the CRO for visibility.

Diego / Marissa — proceed with the counteroffer above and ask Legal to prepare the SOW redlines. If SummitPeak pushes back on the 35%/20k delta and insists on the original ask, escalate back to me immediately with any cover notes — I’ll review the P&L write-up and consider the full concession for final sign-off.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Americas | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 (415) 555-0102
